hero.title: Find & Delete Your Ghost Accounts
hero.subtitle: The average person has 168 online accounts but remembers only 20–30. GhostAccounts scans your inbox, shows you what's hiding in the shadows, and helps you delete what you don't need.

problem.title: Your Forgotten Accounts Are a Ticking Time Bomb
problem.risk1_desc: Old accounts with weak passwords and no 2FA are prime targets for hackers and credential stuffing attacks.
problem.risk2_desc: Companies continue to collect and sell data from inactive accounts — without your knowledge.
problem.risk3_desc: Forgotten subscriptions quietly charge you. The average person loses €62/year to subscription creep.
problem.risk4_desc: Breach monitors only show the damage after it's done. No tool finds ALL your accounts proactively.

features.title: Everything You Need to Reclaim Your Privacy
features.subtitle: GhostAccounts is the only tool that finds ALL your accounts — not just the ones already in data breaches.
features.scan_desc: We scan your inbox for registration emails directly in your browser. No email content ever leaves your device.
features.list_desc: See every service you've ever registered with, when you last used it, and whether it's been breached.
features.score_desc: A clear 0–100 risk score based on account inactivity, breach status, and overall exposure.
features.delete_desc: One-click access to the deletion page for every service, with difficulty rating and status tracking.
features.monitor_desc: Review inactive and potentially exposed accounts after every scan, without storing mailbox contents.
features.privacy_desc: GDPR-compliant by design. Only service names are stored — never email content or personal data.

forecast.title: Ghost Risk Forecast
forecast.subtitle: If you do nothing — what happens in 6 months
forecast.page_subtitle: See how your privacy risk will evolve over the next 6 months if nothing changes.
forecast.how_breach_desc: Services with known vulnerabilities or no recent breach are weighted higher — more accounts means exponentially more risk over time.
forecast.how_inactive_desc: Accounts you haven't used in months are still vulnerable. The forecast projects how this idle footprint grows as a liability.
forecast.how_footprint_desc: The model assumes you continue your current pattern of account creation. Even without new breaches, more accounts = more exposure.

scan.title: New Scan
scan.subtitle: Discover all accounts hidden in your inbox
scan.privacy_desc: The scan runs entirely in your browser. Only service names (e.g. "Spotify", "LinkedIn") are saved — never email content.
scan.demo_desc: See how GhostAccounts works with 30 sample accounts — no account needed.
scan.scanning_desc: This may take 30–60 seconds depending on your inbox size.
scan.pro_rescan_note: Pro users can re-scan regularly to refresh their account inventory.
scan.imap_subtitle: Works with Gmail, Outlook, Yahoo, iCloud, GMX, WEB.DE, T-Online and more.
scan.imap_security_note: Your password is used only for the scan and never stored.
scan.imap_wrong_credentials: Wrong email or password. For Gmail/Outlook/Yahoo you may need an App Password — see the hint below the email field.
scan.imap_connection_failed: Could not connect to your mail server. Check your email address and try again.
scan.imap_generic_error: Something went wrong while scanning. Please try again.
scan.imap_fill_all: Please enter your email address and password.
scan.gmail_oauth_desc: No password needed — sign in directly with your Google account.
scan.gmail_not_configured: Gmail one-click is not configured in this instance. Use the inbox scan above instead.
scan.connected_apps_desc: Also scans for third-party apps connected to your Google account via 'Sign in with Google'.

will.title: Digital Will
will.subtitle: Define what happens to your accounts if you become inactive or pass away. Your digital legacy, on your terms.
will.activate_desc: When active, your instructions will be applied after the defined inactivity period.
will.trigger_desc: After how many months of account inactivity should your will be applied?
will.trigger_note: Your will activates after {months} month(s) of no GhostAccounts activity.
will.action_desc: What should happen to your accounts by default?
will.action_delete_desc: Request deletion from every service automatically.
will.action_transfer_desc: Hand over access instructions to a trusted person.
will.action_archive_desc: Preserve account info without active access.
will.transfer_desc: Who should receive your account information?
will.message_desc: A message that will accompany your will instructions.
will.message_placeholder: e.g. Please delete my social media, archive my work accounts and donate my domain...
will.will_active_note: Will is active and will trigger after the set inactivity period.
will.accounts_subtitle: Override the default action for individual accounts. Click icons to set.
will.no_accounts: No active accounts found. Run a scan first.
will.legal_note: GhostAccounts stores your will instructions securely. We do not automatically execute deletions — your instructions serve as a documented guide for your trusted contacts or executor.
